title: Red Sauce Chicken Fettuccine (Egglife)
description: Doctored jarred red sauce with warmed sous vide chicken breast, tossed with fully cooked Egglife fettuccine at the very end.

ingredients.name: sous vide chicken breasts, already cooked
Egglife Power Pasta fettuccine style, fully cooked
low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: plus a splash more if needed

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Cut {chicken} into 1-inch chunks and set aside. Leave {pasta} in the package for now. It is already cooked and only needs warming at the very end.

steps.title: Bloom the aromatics
steps.text: Melt {butter} in the Dutch oven over medium heat. Add {garlic} and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned. Stir in {paprika}, {umami}, {italian}, {onion} and {pepper} and cook 20 seconds to bloom the spices in the fat.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Pour in {sauce} and {broth}. Simmer over medium-low for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick enough to cling to a spoon. Keep it slightly looser than you want the final sauce, because the pasta will absorb some.

steps.title: Warm the chicken
steps.text: Stir in {chicken} and warm gently for 3 to 4 minutes. Do not boil. The chicken is already cooked, so more heat only dries it out.

steps.title: Add the pasta
steps.text: Shake the {pasta} package gently to separate the strands. Add to the pot and toss with tongs for 1 to 2 minutes, just until warm. If the sauce looks tight, loosen with a splash more broth. Do not go past 2 minutes or the pasta gets soft.

steps.title: Cheese and serve
steps.text: Sprinkle {mozz} and {parm} over the top, cover, and let it sit off the heat for 2 minutes until melted and stretchy. Serve right away in smaller portions with plenty of sauce spooned over.

notes: Egglife pasta is fully cooked, so it is a warm-through step only. Do not boil or bake it. Use the enamel Dutch oven rather than bare cast iron for a long tomato simmer. Leftovers reheat best in a skillet over medium-low with a splash of broth, and the sauce and chicken can be made ahead and the pasta added fresh. Do not freeze with the pasta in it.
